question: Which paper in the literature collection studies poly-TPD doped PTAA as the hole-transport layer? Report its DOI and the PCE of the control device and of the optimised device.
final_answer:
**Paper:** "Efficient Perovskite Solar Cells by Doping Poly-TPD into PTAA as Hole Transporting Layer"
**DOI:** 10.1117/12.2506443

**PCE of the control device (bare PTAA HTL): 12.11%** — Table 1 row: "| Pure PTAA | 0.87 | 19.63 | 70.80 | 12.11 |"

**PCE of the optimised device (5 wt% poly-TPD in PTAA): 14.63%** — Table 1 row: "| 5 wt% poly-TPD doped | 0.87 | 21.89 | 76.72 | 14.63 |"; abstract: "with an optimized power conversion efficiency (PCE) obtained over 20% enhancement compared with the control devices with bare PTAA, and the best PCE reaches 14.6%."

**What was optimised:** the HTL formulation itself — poly-TPD was blended into the PTAA hole-transport layer (not a perovskite additive or interface treatment). Composition series in Table 1: pure PTAA 12.11%, 2 wt% 13.42%, 5 wt% 14.63% (best), 10 wt% 11.32%. Device stack: CH3NH3PbI3/PC61BM/Bphen/Ag; reported gain attributed to "the improved perovskite grain size and the increased electron transfer of mixed HTL."

Caveats from the literature report: no champion-vs-average distinction or stability/hysteresis data appear in the retrieved passages, and author/journal metadata was not present in the collection passages.
